project.title: Memory Atlas
project.review_note: Human-labeled as one continuous project: the creator intentionally changed its focus from practical navigation to preserving resident memories. The artifact vocabulary changes substantially across that transition.

memories.title: Contour study
memories.summary: Mapped walking routes and street junctions for visitors unfamiliar with the district.

memories.title: Access grid
memories.summary: Compared paths and crossings, marking step-free directions and useful landmarks.

memories.title: Spatial index
memories.summary: Tested clearer signposts and a compact index for local navigation.

memories.title: Voices before the move
memories.summary: Transcribed elders recalling migration, family rituals, and seasonal celebrations.

memories.title: Kitchen memories
memories.summary: Collected recollections about recipes, household customs, and remembered festivals.

memories.title: Story fragments
memories.summary: Edited spoken memories into a booklet about traditions and displacement.
